Re-checked Commons 21 Oct 2026 (Category:Hyundai Venue II and searches): still only the 4 Bangalore show files; 09 is the Venue N Line (doors open, show clutter), 251 a stand overview, 258 the interior. No rear view of the second-generation Venue; other 2025 Venue files are first-generation cars from the Philippines, Indonesia and the USA.
cars.notes:
Second-generation Venue (launched Nov 2025, HX trims). hyundai.com price table did not load (only 'from Rs 7,99,900', which matches CarDekho), so prices are CarDekho New Delhi; CarWale Mumbai ranges agree. Dual-tone (DT) paint versions omitted. Specs and trim features from Hyundai brochure dated Apr 2026. The brochure lists HX 6 only as Turbo DCT, but Hyundai's Delhi page and CarDekho also list an HX 6 1.2 MT; HX 6 features are taken from the brochure and its 15-inch steel wheels from Autocar India. 1.0 turbo cylinder count not stated by the sources checked, so null. Mileage conflict for 1.2 MT: Autocar India 18.05 kmpl vs CarDekho 18.5 kmpl; Autocar figure used. Venue N Line has its own price page and is excluded. All trims have 6 airbags. Update 21 Oct 2026: Photos re-checked, no rear found (unchanged). Prices re-checked against CarDekho New Delhi (all match) and CarWale Delhi; no changes. CarWale Delhi lists most non-base variants about Rs 3,000-5,000 lower (lakh-rounded), apparently not yet reflecting Hyundai's 1 Sep 2026 price hike; CarDekho exact figures kept. Mileage unchanged.
Spec audit 21 Oct 2026: t10 cylinders null -> 3 (Zigwheels, Wikipedia). Other figures confirmed; turbo 6MT/7DCT confirmed.

cars.photoNotes: Front is an Indian (Karnataka) 2022 Grand i10 Nios Sportz, front three-quarter, outdoors. It is the current AI3 generation but pre-facelift (facelift came in 2023). No Indian-market rear photo on Commons; the other AI3 files are from Brunei and Mexico, or are the sedan. Re-checked Commons 21 Oct 2026 (Category:Hyundai i10 (AI3) and searches): no Indian photo of the 2023 facelift and no Indian rear. Closest rejected: File:Hyundai Grand i10 1.2 Design 2026 (cropped).jpg (facelift design but Chile-market, front three-quarter) and File:2021 Hyundai Grand i10 Nios 1.0AT Standard red rear view in Brunei.jpg (pre-facelift, Brunei).
cars.notes:
2023 facelift; Hyundai brochure dated Sep 2026. hyundai.com price table did not load; its starting price (Rs 5,59,700) matches CarDekho Era, so CarDekho New Delhi prices used (some, e.g. Magna AMT Rs 6,85,035 and Sportz CNG Rs 7,58,945, are oddly specific, as listed). Dual-tone versions omitted. CarDekho lists Asta VIBE (MT/AMT) and Sportz/Sportz (O) VIBE AMTs, which are not in the brochure or on hyundai.com's variant list; Asta VIBE wheels and features unconfirmed, so left empty or null. hyundai.com names the twin-cylinder CNG 'Dual CNG'; CarDekho calls it 'Sportz Duo CNG'. No official figures were found, so all are labelled unofficial estimates. CNG versions of Sportz get manual AC (petrol gets auto AC) and no cruise control. All confirmed trims have 6 airbags. Update 21 Oct 2026: Photos re-checked, no facelift or rear photo found (unchanged). Prices re-checked against CarDekho New Delhi (all match); CarWale Delhi gives an exact price only for Era (Rs 5,59,700, matches) and a range up to Rs 8.04 lakh vs CarDekho's Rs 8,09,000 top price. No changes. Mileage unchanged (no official figures found).
